introduction_text:
Welcome!

Please share your details to begin onboarding. The form is split into short steps and only takes a few minutes.

Your data is collected solely for employment onboarding and handled per the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your Aadhaar number is stored securely, used only for statutory PF/ESI registration, and shown masked (XXXX XXXX 1234) everywhere except to authorised HR.
name: employee-onboarding
success_message: Thank you! Your details have been submitted. Our HR team will review and reach out to you on the email you provided.
title: Employee Onboarding

web_form_fields.label: Email (becomes your login)
web_form_fields.description: Use an email you check regularly — it becomes your login and receives your welcome/setup email.

web_form_fields.label: PAN
web_form_fields.description: Format ABCDE1234F — 5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter. We auto-uppercase as you type.

web_form_fields.label: Aadhaar Number
web_form_fields.description: Full 12-digit Aadhaar. Stored only for PF/ESI seeding under the consent at the end of this form. We display it masked to other users (XXXX XXXX 1234).

web_form_fields.label: UAN (if any)
web_form_fields.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number from your previous employer's PF (leave blank if first job).

web_form_fields.label: IFSC Code
web_form_fields.description: Format HDFC0001234 — 4 letters + 0 + 6 alphanumeric. Find it on your passbook or chequebook.

web_form_fields.label: My permanent address is the same as my current address
Photo (passport-style, clear face)
web_form_fields.description: Optional. Clear, front-facing passport-style photo (JPG/PNG, up to 5 MB). Becomes your employee profile picture once HR converts your application.

web_form_fields.label: I am a fresher (this is my first job)
web_form_fields.description: Tick this if you have no previous employment — your previous payslip won't be required.

web_form_fields.label: Upload your documents
web_form_fields.description: REQUIRED: PAN Card, Aadhaar Card. Previous Payslip is required unless you ticked 'fresher' above. If you were sent an offer letter to sign (see the banner at the top), the signed copy is required — upload it as 'Signed Offer Letter'. Add a row per document and pick its type.

web_form_fields.label: I consent to my details being processed for onboarding (DPDP Act, 2023) and confirm they are accurate.
web_form_fields.description: Required. You can withdraw consent later by writing to HR — withdrawal does not affect data we are legally required to retain.
